video_summary.overall_goal: Search unified inbox for an email and open the matching result
video_summary.description: User starts on the Unified Inbox screen, taps the search icon, types 'Hi', selects a suggestion, views search results showing one match ('Hello World'), and taps the result to open it.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Unified Inbox list screen with hamburger menu, title, search icon, compose/pencil icon, sort icon, overflow menu
steps.visual_feedback: Static inbox screen, no visible list items due to lighting/dark screen

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Unified Inbox screen with finger tapping the search icon in the top app bar
steps.visual_feedback: Screen transitions to search text field with on-screen keyboard visible
steps.intent_task: Open search to find a specific email

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Search field with placeholder 'Search', QWERTY keyboard open
steps.system_response: Text 'Hi' appears in search field; keyboard shows word suggestions 'Hi', 'Ho', 'Ji'
steps.visual_feedback: Search field shows 'Hi' with cursor, suggestion bar active

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Finger tapping keyboard action/enter key to submit search
steps.system_response: Search executes, navigates to Search results screen

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Search results screen titled 'Search results' showing one email: 'Hello World' from sender icon 'E', to ezioaltair1524@gmail.com, snippet 'Hi', timestamp 9:17 PM
steps.visual_feedback: Single search result 'Hello World' visible and static
steps.intent_task: View search results before selecting one

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Finger tapping on the 'Hello World' email list item in search results
steps.system_response: Screen begins transition, header area starts collapsing/changing as email opens
steps.visual_feedback: Top bar text becomes unreadable/faded during transition, star icon and timestamp still partially visible
steps.intent_task: Open the matched email to view its content

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Screen mid-transition into email detail view, top bar mostly blank/dark, content area not yet rendered
steps.visual_feedback: Screen darker/blank at top, indicating screen still loading email content
steps.intent_task: Wait for email detail screen to finish loading

overall_flow: Tap search icon to open search bar
Tap the 'Hello World' result to open it
Email detail screen begins loading (video ends before fully rendered)
human_readable_step_summary: User is on the Unified Inbox screen.
User taps the search icon to start a search.
User types 'Hi' into the search field.
Search results show a single email titled 'Hello World'.
User taps the 'Hello World' search result to open it.
The email detail screen begins loading; video ends before content fully appears.
